comment: Case library. 'recognition' drives automatic matching: oll = U-face orientation pattern, pll = LL side permutation, f2l = FR-slot pair location, none = drill/playback only. All algs are validated mechanically at test time: an alg that does not produce a state of its claimed kind fails the build.
